pagedata.pyUsage:
This activity basically gathers all the parameters for email and passes them to send email function.
From: It accepts email address as per Email Address specification defined in RFC with only lcoal part and domain seperated by @
To/CC/BCC : It accepts one or more email addresses separated by "," or ";".Email Address should adhere to internet email address specification as defined in RFC. We recommend separating email addresses with "," when there are multiple email addresses. Please note the below limitation when email address contains display name with ";" in it. Semicolon is replaced by comma when message is delivered to the email server which might cause issues when display name is used in down stream processing Input to To/CC/BCC:"foo;bar"<foo@bar> Mail sent to "foo,bar"<foo@bar>. There won't be any functional impact and mail will be received by mentioned mailbox .
